title: Silver jewellery for college students: affordable starters
description: A budget-friendly silver jewellery plan for college students: which starter pieces to buy first, where to save and splurge, and how to care for them in a hostel.
intro: If you are a college student on a budget, buy one good 925 silver pendant first and wear it often, then fill out the rest of your look with inexpensive fashion jewellery for fests and functions. One real silver piece that goes with everything is better value than five cheap pieces that tarnish or break in a month.

sections.heading: Why start with real silver at all?
paragraphs: Cheap 'silver look' jewellery is tempting when money is tight. The trouble is that many of these pieces are thinly plated base metal. After a few weeks of daily wear, the coating can rub off, the colour changes and some leave marks on skin.

Sterling silver costs more upfront but behaves differently. It can be cleaned and polished again and again, does not reveal a different metal underneath, and keeps some value because it is real silver. Spread across a few years of college, one good piece often works out cheaper than repeatedly replacing fashion pieces.

sections.heading: The four-piece starter plan
paragraphs: You do not need much. These four pieces cover lectures, internships, dates and fests between them. Buy them one at a time, as your budget allows.
list: First: a simple 925 silver pendant on an 18-inch chain. A small CZ solitaire or a clean geometric shape works with T-shirts, kurtis and shirts alike.
Second: a pair of small silver studs or tiny hoops that you can wear every day and sleep in without discomfort.
Third: one fun statement piece for fests and weddings. This is where inexpensive fashion jewellery makes sense.
Fourth: a watch you actually like, which does more for a put-together look than most people expect.

sections.heading: Where to save and where to spend
paragraphs: Spend on the pieces you will wear most often, against your skin, for long hours. That is your everyday pendant and studs. These benefit most from being real silver.

Save on the occasional pieces. For a college fest, a cousin's sangeet or a Navratri night, you need impact for a few hours, not durability for years. Varaha's [Kundan earrings](/women/earrings) start around ₹256, and the [under ₹999 section](/shop?max=999) has more fashion pieces at student-friendly prices. These are imitation jewellery, not silver, so treat them as party pieces.

For the silver pendant itself, Varaha's [925 sterling silver pendants](/silver) range from ₹1,453 to ₹2,320. If that is a stretch, it is worth saving up for one, or putting it on a birthday wishlist, rather than settling for a plated piece that will not last.

sections.heading: Making one pendant look different every day
paragraphs: Wear it short and tucked in at the collarbone with a shirt for a presentation day. Wear it over a plain tee for classes. Layer it with a longer, inexpensive chain for a night out. Pair it with bold earrings for a function and let the pendant play a quiet supporting role. One piece, four looks, no extra money spent.

sections.heading: Hostel and PG care tips
paragraphs: Hostel life is hard on jewellery: shared bathrooms, small rooms, humid weather, and very little storage space. A few habits help a lot.
list: Keep each silver piece in its own small zip pouch, with the air pressed out, inside your cupboard rather than on an open shelf.
Never leave jewellery in a shared bathroom. Steam speeds up tarnish, and small pieces go missing.
Take your pendant off before the gym, sports practice or a swim.
Carry a small silver polishing cloth. A quick wipe once a week keeps tarnish from building up.
Do not lend silver to friends for long periods. It is how most pieces get lost.

sections.heading: Spotting a fake when buying cheap
paragraphs: If a listing for 'silver' jewellery is priced far below what silver pieces usually cost, be careful. Check whether it says 925 or sterling clearly, or just 'silver tone' or 'silver colour'. Look for a stamp on the piece once it arrives, and test it with a magnet. Real silver is not magnetic.

Buy where returns are possible. Varaha offers 7-day returns and cash on delivery, which gives you room to check a piece before you are fully committed. Free delivery applies to orders of ₹499 and above.

faq.q: What is a good first silver jewellery piece?
faq.a: A simple 925 silver pendant on an 18-inch chain. It suits most outfits and can be worn every day.
It costs more than fashion jewellery but far less than gold. One good piece, worn often, can be good value over a few years.

faq.q: Can I wear silver jewellery in a hostel every day?
faq.a: Yes. Just remove it before bathing and sports, and store it in a zip pouch away from bathroom humidity.
